title: The Antimicrobial Resistome in the ICU: Associations With Phenotypic Susceptibility Patterns
summary: Despite major advances in medicine over the past decades, mortality from bacterial bloodstream infections has remained persistently high. In addition, the increasing prevalence of antibiotic resistance complicates treatment. Therefore, this study aims to investigate how accurately new methods can determine resistance and how well they can predict those resistances before treatment.

interventions.name: As part of the observational study, residual clinical materials (e.g. gastrointestinal tract samples, skin swabs, and respiratory secretions) from patients in a surgical intensive care unit will be collected.
